//: Extends the repo base, not `agents/tsconfig`. Inheriting a config out of node_modules meant the one package Vite actually bundles was the one package our own base config did not govern: it ran at ES2021 without `resolveJsonModule`, and a dependency bump could have changed its module settings. The Worker-shaped parts — DOM libs, workers-types, the React JSX runtime — are declared here because they are genuinely cf-backend's, and `verbatimModuleSyntax` moved to the base so this package keeps the check it already had while every other project gains it.
